name: Old Town Square
description: Begin among medieval façades and look for the Astronomical Clock before the square becomes busy.

name: Charles Bridge
description: Cross the Vltava slowly and enjoy views of the river, Malá Strana and the castle above the rooftops.

name: Kampa Island
description: Pause beside the water, walk through the park and explore the quiet lanes around the old mill wheel.

name: Prague Castle
description: Finish with courtyards, Gothic architecture and a wide evening panorama over the city.
